title: ID0392266-DC/Si-D/DE[170003981] - Plug stuck
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Plug stuck
Root cause:
Failed authentication leads to ~3mins of waiting because of timeout. Customer tries to unplug the EV during this timeout which is not possible since it's in B2 state
Solution:
Wait the timeout time or press the Estop button
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

Hello Anna, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
Here are my findings from 25th November:
You reported that the session was at 8pm CET which is 7pm GMT. The only session I can see that was performed with a range of 2hours was this one:
After the session finishes correctly, the vehicle stops the charging:
And goes to available after 5 seconds:
The request to stop was performed at:
So from the scan until the remove of the plug there was 7 seconds. Before this session there were 3 other sessions which failed during authentication, if that is the case:
After the failed session we can only plug out after 2min40sec:
Please confirm which one is the bad session, if it's latest one as it's more than 2mins (makes more sense) then it was the driver that didn't present the RFID to start the charging session.
Please share with me all your thoughts and questions.
I hope I was clear in my explanation.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0392266-DC/Si-D/DE[170003981] - Plug stuck CRM:00315002113
additional_info.body:
Hello Anna, good afternoon. I hope all is well.
I'm glad I was clear, one thing I must say is that if you are in the authentication and can't plug out it's because you need this timeout of approx. 3mins. After this timer it always comes out.
I must recommend to not restart the charger if this happens as it might corrupt the charging controller and that's why the EV continued in stuck position.
If you don't have a Emergency stop button then please avoid restarting the charger with an EV plugged in.
Let me know if you are satisfied with my answer and if I can close the ticket.
From the timer you provided there was no evidence of other charging sessions where it might be stuck.
Thank you very much and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco
